welcome.title: You are the Game Master
welcome.description: This screen is your private guide: read the question aloud, lead the investigation, and keep the answer hidden until the group reaches it. Players ask questions, and you answer Yes/No or offer two choices. You may give hints when they are stuck; the goal is for everyone to have fun.

framework.title: Set the framework
framework.description: Before the investigation begins, announce the framework shown here: the theme, category, and difficulty. The difficulty indicates how hard the question may be to deduce; it is not a score or a timer.

question.title: Read and narrow the question
question.description: Read this question aloud to the group. They can investigate by asking questions while you answer Yes or No, or offer two choices when a question is too open. Rephrase questions when needed: the goal is to narrow the possibilities, not to demand a particular format. Wrong leads are useful because they help the group rule things out.

clues.title: Use the built-in clues
clues.description: Some questions include Context and Trivia. Open it when the group is stuck or when you need extra information to judge a lead, then use the details to give a measured hint. The group should investigate from the card: no Google, Wikipedia, or AI research during the game. Keep the most revealing details for the right moment.

answer.title: Judge the answer
answer.description: The Answer is your solution reference. Keep it hidden while the group investigates. Players do not need to repeat the exact wording: accept a different phrasing when they have understood the concept. As the Game Master, you decide when their answer is close enough.

sources.title: Reveal the story and use sources
sources.description: Once the group reaches the solution, reveal the answer and the story behind it. Use Context and Trivia when available to share the background and interesting details. The provided Sources can help you answer deeper questions about the subject: open them during the game when needed.

continue.title: Continue the game
continue.description: When the investigation is complete, select Next question to continue. If you need to revisit the previous card, use Previous when it is available. You can also hand the Game Master role to someone else before moving on.

sidebar.title: Find help in the sidebar
sidebar.description: The sidebar gives you access to the available options and settings, the full Rules, and this Interactive tutorial whenever you want to review them.
